## Change

Describe the user-visible or operational change.

## Safety and release checklist

- [ ] I did not add beneficiary personal data, credentials, private keys, or unpublished locations.
- [ ] Listing changes cite public sources and preserve the required verification gates.
- [ ] Payment and activity features remain disabled unless every required approval is recorded.
- [ ] CI passes and I reviewed the Netlify Deploy Preview.
- [ ] Any production data or schema impact is described for the reviewer.
